# cycle_ip_pools (Data Source)

Lists Cycle IP pools in the hub. The API reports available/total IP counts only; it does not enumerate individual addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every IP pool in the hub. The API reports available/total counts
# only — it does not enumerate individual addresses.
data "cycle_ip_pools" "all" {}

output "available_ips" {
  value = sum([for pool in data.cycle_ip_pools.all.ip_pools : pool.ips_available])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ip_pools` (Attributes List) The list of IP pools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_pools))

<a id="nestedatt--ip_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_pools`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) The CIDR block for the pool.
- `floating` (Boolean) Whether this is a floating IP pool.
- `gateway` (String) The gateway address for the pool.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the IP pool.
- `ips_available` (Number) Number of IPs in the pool that are still available to assign. The API does not list the individual addresses.
- `ips_total` (Number) Total number of IPs in the pool.
- `kind` (String) The type of IP pool.
- `location_id` (String) The location ID associated with the pool.
- `server_id` (String) The server ID associated with the pool, if any.
- `state` (String) The current state of the pool.
